entities.summary: Canal 1 (English: Channel 1; pronounced "Canal Uno" is a Colombian free-to-air television channel. It is owned by HMTV1, a subsidiary of Hemisphere Media Group and managed by Phoenix Media, a private company. From 1957 to 2017, the channel was administered by private programming companies known as programadoras, which bid for time slots with the Colombian state.
